summary: The application root is an entry gate: authenticated visitors continue to /app/dashboard and everyone else is sent to /login
The public TradesStack marketing landing page, early-access and contact-sales routes are removed from the customer application
The login page presents a dedicated-workspace sign-in message without public registration, early-access or back-to-website links
Public self-registration is disabled in the Supabase Auth baseline; account creation is invitation-only and provisioned server-side through the Auth admin API
Password recovery is available at /forgot-password and /reset-password
No database migration change; the phase1o-1 baseline and 20261019120000 migration target are unchanged

hostedConfiguration.customerSupabaseAuth: Set disable_signup=true and allow <site>/reset-password as a recovery redirect URL through the approved customer upgrade process
